{{redirect|Angela|Erika's Tangela named Angela|Erika#Angela|Angela}} [[File:Angela.png|thumb|250px|Angela]] '''Angela''' (Japanese: '''イチコ''' ''Ichiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG156|From Cradle to Save]]''. She is the teacher of a [[Pokémon Ninja School]] located in a forest, and is a very skillful ninja. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met her when [[Evian]] took them to the Pokémon Ninja School. {{an|Brock}} jumped toward her, but seconds later, she appeared as a substitution of herself as a log with similar clothing. She revealed herself in a nearby treetop, amazing all the students with her actions. She presided over a training session with Ash and his friends as special students. When the school was under attack by {{TRT}}, Angela sent her {{p|Shiftry}} into {{pkmn|battle}}, destroying the trio's [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]]. [[Jessie]] attacked her by running around uncontrollably and creating many clones of herself. Angela had Shiftry use {{m|Double Team}}, which created a {{m|Whirlwind}} effect, rotating Team Rocket at a high speed. An {{p|Ariados}} entangled the trio with its web, trapping them inside and they were rolled off a nearby cliff with the ball of webbing. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Angela's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Angela |pkmn=Kecleon |type1=Normal |img=Angela Kecleon.png |epnum=AG156 |epname=From Cradle To Save |desc=Angela ordered her {{p|Kecleon}} to hide as she told Evian and the others to go find it as part of their ninja training. None of Kecleon's moves are known and its Ability is {{a|Color Change}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Angela |pkmn=Shiftry |type1=Grass |type2=Dark |img=Angela Shiftry.png |epnum=AG156 |epname=From Cradle To Save |desc={{p|Shiftry}} is Angela's main battling Pokémon. It was used to handle of Team Rocket after they tried to steal the Pokémon of the school. Shiftry's known moves are {{m|Aerial Ace}}, {{m|Rock Smash}}, {{m|Double Team}}, and {{m|Razor Wind}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=松本さち ''Sachi Matsumoto'' |en=Jessica Wachsman |it=Laura Brambilla |fi=Jenni Sivonen |es_eu=Amparo Bravo |pt_br=Priscila Ferreira}}
